guardian.eye.text: Iron first. Tide second. Both at the last. A broken seal never mends. Defeat the warden, then take what it guards.

upper.eye.text: Two strengths keep you standing. Bone fears steel; the marked tail fears blue fire. Take the rune beyond the watchman.

upper.camp.name: Lantern shelter
upper.camp.text: Spend one ration to mend both strengths. Prepare before you descend.

spirit.eye.name: The closed eye
spirit.eye.text: Water guards the mind. Put on the ring. A hollow seam beside the book hides a forgotten way.

spirit.secret.name: The hollow seam

spirit.chest.name: The ticking coffer
spirit.chest.hint: A taut silver wire crosses the latch. DISARM is safe; forcing it deals 6 War before defense.

spirit.secret.name: The hollow seam
spirit.secret.clue: A thin blue crack. The stone sounds hollow.

guardian.camp.name: The last warm lantern
guardian.camp.text: Share a ration with a fallen companion. The warden waits beyond the throat of the engine.

guardian.eye.name: The iron eye
guardian.eye.text: Iron first. Tide second. Both at the last. A broken seal never mends. Defeat the warden, then take what it guards.

upper.eye.name: The watching eye
upper.eye.text: Two strengths keep you standing. Bone fears steel; the marked tail fears blue fire. Take the rune beyond the watchman.

upper.camp.name: Lantern shelter
upper.camp.text: Spend one ration to mend both strengths. Prepare before you descend.
